This call for tenders concerns a Joint Procurement, between the European Commission on behalf of the European Cybersecurity Industrial, Technology and Research Competence Centre (“ECCC”) and the ENSOC Consortium, comprising of (1) Centro Nacional de Inteligencia - Centro Criptológico Nacional, Spain, (the“Coordinator”) (2) Agenzia per la Cybersicurezza Nazionale, Italy, (3) Luxembourg House of Cybersecurity, Luxembourg, (4) Gabinete Nacional de Segurança (Centro Nacional de Cibersegurança), Portugal, (5) Directoratul National de Securitate Cibernetica (National Cyber Security Directorate of Romania), (6) Bundesministerium für Inneres (Federal Ministry of the Interior of Austria) and (7) the Ministry of Justice and Security of the Netherlands, National Cyber Security Centre. 
The subject of this call for tenders is the joint acquisition of ENSOC Cross-Border SOCs Platform infrastructure (including cloud), specialised software development services and CTI feeds services.
